pairs.subject: engine-integration-safety
pairs.evidence: src/lib/bridge-doctor/probes.ts:357 The bridge doctor files a DNS failure (wrong host) and a generic browser 'failed to fetch' (line 358) under 'editor-not-running' instead of 'unknown'. The remediation for that kind (remediation.ts:80) then tells the operator to open the Unreal Editor, so they are sent to fix something the probe never saw fail.

techniques.evidence: src/lib/bridge-doctor/probes.ts:357 Classification happens at the boundary with a typed ProbeFailureKind (refused/timeout/auth/404/wrong-port/unknown), which is good. But ENOTFOUND and 'failed to fetch' get the guessed cause 'editor-not-running' when they should be 'unknown'. The rule is that a named cause must be one that was actually observed. Separately, bridgeDoctorStore.ts:145 `catch {` throws away a probe exception's kind during restore preview and returns null with no reason.

src/lib/bridge-doctor/probes.ts:149 Status pings get a deliberately short 3000ms bound (line 61, rationale at 56-57), which the technique's 'cheap side-effect-free reads' carve-out allows. When the bound fires it produces a distinct 'timeout' kind that states the budget, separate from 'editor-not-running'. The caller can override the bound via cfg.timeoutMs.
src/lib/bridge-doctor/remediation.ts:80 Nothing blocks an automated run here. The doctor only reports and hands the action to the human; it never starts, closes or restarts the editor.
src/lib/bridge-doctor/probes.ts:90 Probes are read-only GETs. Grep across the context's paths and src/lib/bridge-doctor found no spawn, kill or taskkill, so there is no spawned process to tear down.
src/stores/bridgeDoctorStore.ts:128 The only exclusivity guard is a UI re-entry guard on the diagnostics run. Nothing here drives the non-reentrant editor in a way that needs a lease.

src/app/api/crash-analyzer/route.ts:52 Crash logs come in as operator-pasted text and are parsed for diagnosis. No headless run is launched, so there is no run outcome to judge from markers or an exit code.
src/app/api/crash-analyzer/route.ts:24 Analysis runs in-process over stored samples and history. No batch of checks shares a launch of the heavyweight application.
